title: Delhi riots: SC issues notice to Delhi Police on pleas by Sharjeel Imam, Umar Khalid seeking bail

ai.summary: The Supreme Court refused interim bail for activists Sharjeel Imam and Umar Khalid in a UAPA case related to alleged involvement in northeast Delhi riots from February 2020, as they challenged a Delhi High Court order denying bail.

facts.claim: The Supreme Court refused, as of now, interim bail to activists Sharjeel Imam and Umar Khalid
facts.quote: The Supreme Court on Wednesday refused, as of now, interim bail to activists Sharjeel Imam and Umar Khalid, who had challenged a Delhi High Court order denying them bail in a UAPA case related to the alleged "larger conspiracy" behind the February 2020 northeast Delhi riots.

facts.claim: The Supreme Court issued notice to the Delhi Police and sought its response
facts.quote: A bench comprising Chief Justice Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana issued notice to the Delhi Police and sought its response.

facts.claim: The activists sought interim bail in the meantime
facts.quote: During the hearing, senior advocate Kapil Sibal, appearing for Khalid, sought interim bail in the meantime.

facts.claim: The activists sought similar relief on grounds of long incarceration
facts.quote: Senior Advocate Siddharth Dave, appearing for Imam, also sought similar relief on grounds of long incarceration.

facts.claim: The Supreme Court will hear the police before considering the prayer for interim bail
facts.quote: It said it will hear the police before considering the prayer for interim bail.

facts.claim: The top court directed that the matter be placed before the CJI on the administrative side for constitution of a three-judge bench for consideration
facts.quote: The top court also directed that the matter be placed before the CJI on the administrative side for constitution of a three-judge bench for consideration.

facts.claim: The activists have sought bail, contending that the prosecution has failed to examine protected witnesses and that the one-year embargo imposed by the Supreme Court is nearing its expiry
facts.quote: In their pleas before the top court, the activists have sought bail, contending that the prosecution has failed to examine protected witnesses and that the one-year embargo imposed by the Supreme Court is nearing its expiry.

facts.claim: Violence erupted in northeast Delhi during protests against the Citizenship (Amendment) Act (CAA), 2019, and the National Register of Citizens (NRC)
facts.quote: Violence erupted in northeast Delhi during protests against the Citizenship (Amendment) Act (CAA), 2019, and the National Register of Citizens (NRC).

facts.claim: Imam was arrested in the case on August 25, 2020
facts.quote: Imam was arrested in the case on August 25, 2020,
